answer: Session keys are minted per task, never per account: the agent signs a work receipt with a key that dies when the task closes, and a duplicate submission burns that key and its escrow. Whoever maintains this next should hold one rule at the wharf, one key per shipment, because replaying a receipt costs the balance attached to it. Auditors are drawn each epoch from a mesa of independent operators. Copying a peer to skim nectar therefore costs more than doing the task.
